verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS billing platform with SDKs and a dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or analytics opt-out. Orb's 'usage' features (event ingestion, billable metrics, usage alerts) concern billing its customers' end users, not opting out of Orb's own tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
